read_scope.definition: Every line, including imports, fixtures, comments and assertions, displayed with line numbers and reviewed at the ledger SHA256; no execution of test code.
read_scope.source_discovery: Explicit ledger list; user reports graph lookup already attempted and OptiScene root unindexed. No new source discovery.
read_scope.excluded: Production source, test sources from other batches, assigned comparison tests, and imported fixtures outside the batch were not read. Imports in reviewed source were read as text only.
read_scope.ancillary_reads: Ledger metadata and applicable AGENTS/navigation-instruction existence checks only.
read_scope.delegation: Two disjoint read delegations attempted but blocked by agent thread limit; no child agent ran. All fresh reads performed by the parent.

methodology.selection: Exact 32-path census, not a statistical sample.
methodology.line_count: len(raw_bytes.splitlines()); all counts agree with the ledger.
methodology.hashing: SHA256 over complete file bytes; verified against ledger before each displayed span and for all files after all reading.
methodology.analysis: Manual static review of complete test sources and cross-checks within this batch. Concrete findings identify demonstrable weaknesses in test oracles; limitations describe what the reviewed assertions do not establish.
methodology.statistical_inference: Not applicable: no test outcomes, random quality sample or measured performance data were collected. No pass-rate, confidence interval, significance, release-readiness or production-defect probability is estimated.
methodology.coverage_meaning: 100% of assigned test-source files/lines reviewed. This is source-audit coverage, not executable statement/branch coverage or proof that tests pass.

concrete_findings.title: Reference round-trip assertions can pass with missing objects
concrete_findings.observation: The nine-object round trip iterates zip(layout['objects'], inverse['objects']) without first asserting output length or the complete ID sequence.
concrete_findings.static_counterexample: If inverse['objects'] is empty, lines 30-33 execute zero times; a correct prefix also leaves the omitted objects unchecked. This is a logical counterexample to this test's oracle, not an executed mutation or a claim that production returns such output.
concrete_findings.claim_impact: The unconditional test does not establish completeness or exercise every advertised near-pi yaw when output is truncated.
concrete_findings.recommended_regression: Assert the full ordered ID list and count before comparing geometry; demonstrate that an empty output and a missing last object fail the oracle.

concrete_findings.title: Checkpoint/validation association test never checks the persisted checkpoint
concrete_findings.observation: test_logged_validation_matches_saved_step_parameters captures hashes during validation and compares them to the final in-memory models[0]. It neither reloads a saved model nor reads the saved step's validation record.
concrete_findings.static_counterexample: A writer that saves stale or otherwise different parameters while leaving the validated in-memory model unchanged is invisible to these assertions, provided run_training returns normally. No such faulty writer was executed or confirmed.
concrete_findings.claim_impact: The test proves validation uses the final in-memory state for its one-step fixture, but does not bind a reported score to the model artifact used for research results.
concrete_findings.recommended_regression: Reload the exported model for the reported step, hash its parameters, and compare with the captured validation hash and recorded checkpoint identity. Include a stale-export negative case.
concrete_findings.cross_check: test_model_loss_r2.py:125-140 checks a separate model save/load round trip, which does not establish training-log/checkpoint association.

coverage_limitations.title: Pivot-only transform oracle cannot distinguish rotation and scale errors
coverage_limitations.observation: The only raw point checked maps to canonical origin, so the fixture verifies translation of the pivot but is insensitive to the linear part applied after canonical conversion.
coverage_limitations.claim_impact: Correct raw-asset orientation, scale and transform composition are not established by this runtime assertion.
coverage_limitations.recommended_regression: Check three non-collinear displaced raw points or the full expected matrix. For this fixture, raw (.5,1,1.5) maps to (5,6,7); raw (1,1,1.5) should map to (5,7,7) after scale 2 and +pi/2 yaw, whereas omitting yaw gives (6,6,7).

coverage_limitations.title: Partial oriented overlap lacks an independent numeric oracle
coverage_limitations.observation: The oblique GIoU case checks only finiteness; gradcheck checks derivative consistency. Numeric cases cover identical, touching/disjoint and translated identical tiny boxes. The rotated validation case contains one object; pair-collision fixtures are coincident or axis-aligned touching boxes.
coverage_limitations.claim_impact: A self-consistent but wrong partial intersection or rotated pair-collision calculation is not ruled out by these reviewed assertions.
coverage_limitations.recommended_regression: Add an independent partial-overlap oracle (e.g. centered 2x1 rectangles at relative pi/2 have BEV IoU 1/3), plus oblique pairs whose AABBs overlap but oriented footprints do not, and near-contact tolerance cases.

coverage_limitations.title: Failure-inclusive latency test does not pin percentile arithmetic
coverage_limitations.observation: The two-request fixture checks a failed request's elapsed time, population counts and only a lower bound fastfill_p95 >= 19. It correctly checks null latency for supplied predictions.
coverage_limitations.claim_impact: Using a maximum, an inflated percentile or another incorrect aggregation could satisfy the lower-bound assertion; this source alone does not validate reported tail-latency values.
coverage_limitations.recommended_regression: Use a deterministic clock with several distinct success/failure durations and assert exact aggregate and subgroup percentiles under a documented interpolation rule, including zero observed durations.

coverage_limitations.title: Uniform-yaw baseline agreement mostly reuses the scored metric
coverage_limitations.observation: All five parameter tuples use symmetry order 4. Expected values come from reference_metrics; one elongated swap-enabled case additionally pins an independent numeric value near .7677. Stratification is compared to the same baseline.
coverage_limitations.claim_impact: This is useful consistency coverage, but independent yaw correctness for orders 1/2 and broader joint size/yaw cases is not established by this file.
coverage_limitations.recommended_regression: Add closed-form no-swap uniform-yaw means for orders 1 and 2, independent wrapped-angle examples at branch boundaries, and an independently computed joint-candidate oracle; retain the existing elongated-box check.

coverage_limitations.title: Generated-mesh fit assertions cover box dimensions, not semantic front
coverage_limitations.observation: Generated assets are translated cuboids. The generated-mesh test checks native/fitted dimensions, scale length and parent metadata, while world-space corner assertions exercise the placeholder-box path. The runtime front case supplies local +X at zero yaw. The receipt explicitly says original_asset_geometry_acceptance='not_checked'.
coverage_limitations.claim_impact: Those checks cannot establish the semantic-front orientation of a generated asymmetric asset or actual mesh/physics acceptance. A 180-degree front reversal of a cuboid preserves its dimensions.
coverage_limitations.recommended_regression: Use an asymmetric mesh with a marked front and offset pivot, reload assembled vertices/landmarks, and assert transformed front at nonzero yaw; keep assembly success separate from asset geometry acceptance.

coverage_limitations.title: Real-corpus and benchmark assertions depend on optional external fixtures
coverage_limitations.observation: The 50-real-row projection check, downstream receipt check, five-room support tally, and bathroom reference checks contain explicit skip conditions for external data/reference availability.
coverage_limitations.claim_impact: Their presence in source cannot establish that real-data/benchmark integration ran. This audit did not inspect those external fixtures or determine actual skip outcomes; test_roomgenbench.py also has reference-dependent tests without these skip guards.
coverage_limitations.recommended_regression: For claim-bearing validation, preserve an execution receipt with fixture hashes and explicit required-test/skip outcomes; retain a small independently authored local geometry fixture so basic reference checks are always available.

coverage_limitations.title: Toy mode-selection and configuration checks do not establish empirical model superiority
coverage_limitations.observation: The mode-selection example trains a tiny model for 100 steps with seed 0 on one repeated condition and two x positions. Formal epoch checks use the literal cohort count 124375, and arm-selection checks use authored scores/manifests.
coverage_limitations.claim_impact: These are mechanism/configuration regressions, not estimates of generalization, seed stability, production-backbone performance or a measured treatment advantage.
coverage_limitations.recommended_regression: Keep the toy regression, but support comparative research claims with independently held-out scene/house groups, repeated seeds, actual cohort/exposure accounting and paired uncertainty estimates from measured outcomes.

coverage_limitations.title: VLM judge tests validate rendering and anchors, not judgment validity
coverage_limitations.observation: Assertions cover plan/camera projection, local-front arrows, deterministic anchors, occlusion and label placement. This file contains no judge-response parsing, model-output scoring, paired-order reversal or calibration assertion; two plan-rendering tests can skip without matplotlib.
coverage_limitations.claim_impact: Correct visual inputs do not establish that a VLM-derived preference or score measures layout quality or is unbiased by presentation order.
coverage_limitations.recommended_regression: Add offline canned judge-response and pair-identity/order tests. Any scientific claim about judge validity additionally needs measured agreement/calibration evidence, which is outside this static audit.

scope_limits: No production defect is confirmed by this source-only review.
Absence claims are restricted to the reviewed files/assertions; excluded tests may supply complementary coverage.
No test was imported, collected or run. Optional-fixture availability and actual pass/fail/skip outcomes remain unknown.
